description: Supplies the localized text shown on each character's in-game command-list page: character overview, passive skills, and the name/description of each standard, cursed-energy, super, and character-specific extra attack. Text keys double as visibility switches when set to None.

Id.simple: Command-list row identifier, normally a character ID.
Id.technical: FName key fetched from CommandListDataTables using Character::Id_CommandList; the widget returns without populating anything when the character has no command-list ID or no matching row.

Id_CommandListText_CharacterDescription.simple: Localized key for the character overview paragraph.

Id_CommandListText_PassiveName.simple: Localized names of the character passive skills, one per slot.
Id_CommandListText_PassiveName.technical: TArray<FName> indexed by the zero-based passive widget slot. A slot is skipped when the index is invalid or either its name or description is None. The name is inserted as the SKILL_NAME parameter of SYS_COMMANDLIST_LABEL_0002.

Id_CommandListText_PassiveDescription.simple: Localized descriptions of the passive skills.
Id_CommandListText_PassiveDescription.technical: TArray<FName> parallel to Id_CommandListText_PassiveName; the selected slot is shown with SetTextIdOnly. Both arrays must contain a non-None value at the same index for the passive widget to appear.

Id_CommandListText_NormalAttack_1_Name.technical: FName copied into the attack widget parameter as NameTextId. A None name hides the corresponding widget; the exported CP_050/CP_170 extra-attack rows are the only rows with non-None keys for those two slots.

Id_CommandListText_NormalAttack_1_Descri.technical: FName copied into the attack widget parameter as DescriptionTextId. It is paired with the same-slot Name key; the name alone controls widget visibility.

CommandListAttackPropertyType_NormalAtta.simple: Serialized attack-property tags for normal attack 1.
CommandListAttackPropertyType_NormalAtta.technical: TArray<EGameCommandListAttackPropertyType> declared on the row; the enum values are None, DirectAttack, Shooting, Buff, Debuff, Heal, Trap, Special, DomainExpansion, Invalid=255. No source consumer was identified; the command widget instead clears PropertyIconResources, so these tags do not drive visible property icons in the reconstructed retail flow.

notes: This export has 27 rows and one identified C++ consumer, UGameCommandListWidget. The row is selected indirectly: Character::Id_CommandList, not the UI widget, determines which row is fetched from CommandListDataTables.

For every attack entry the corresponding widget is populated with the row's NameTextId and DescriptionTextId and hidden when the name is None; command-button labels, category colors, attack-set IDs and energy type come from widget-local maps and other tables (Action/UI/Character), not from this table.

The 11 CommandListAttackPropertyType_* arrays and Id_CommandListText_TagComboAttack_Name have no identified C++ consumer in the available Source. They are included because they are serialized in the reconstructed row struct and exported retail data, but their runtime behavior and constraints are not documented; no Blueprint logic is assumed.
Only the exported retail table and partial Content are available; additional shards or editor-only uses cannot be ruled out.

usages.detail: Sets up the command list by finding the row named by the selected character's Id_CommandList.
Sets the character overview text from the row's character-description key.
Iterates the passive widget slots, reads aligned name/description arrays, and shows only slots where both keys are present and not None; the name is passed as a SKILL_NAME text parameter.
Builds each normal-attack action widget from the paired name/description keys and hides its widget when the name is None.
Builds cursed-energy attack widgets from their name/description keys plus Action-table attack sets and UI energy type.
Builds the super-cursed-energy widget from its name/description keys.
Shows the CP_050 and CP_170 extra-attack widgets only when their respective name keys are not None.
